gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Epson PowerLite L690U it recommended has an HDBaseT input. That means the booth computer can feed the ceiling-mounted projector over one Cat 5e STP (or better) cable up to 100 m with an HDBaseT transmitter at the booth (Epson). It also means turning on the projector's Control Communications setting switches off its LAN and RS-232C ports (Epson). AV Access's HDBaseT extender from an approved store is sold only as a $227.99 transmitter + receiver pair and carries 4K only 70 m on Cat 5e/6.
standout_why: ProjectorCentral's 'Top 10 House of Worship Church Projectors November 2026' (read 2026-11-10) never mentions HDBaseT, extenders, mounts or screens. Its only cabling note is 3G-SDI 'for daisy-chaining and long cable runs' on two Epson models. iTechGuides' mid-size sanctuary guide lists 'HDBaseT listed' as a spec-table label and says 'A long run may need an appropriate transport method', with no cable type, distance, menu setting or transmitter. So it holds only a hint of this. I couldn't read projectorsourcing.com (TLS certificate error in the fetch tool), so I can't rule it out. I didn't open the other results (Panasonic, BenQ PDF, aafrc, laptopbee and others). ChatGPT's own answers end with 'distance from the projector to the screen' and say nothing about getting the signal there. The finding is new and useful. It doesn't decide the set by itself, because I couldn't price the Amazon cart that would hold it.
kit_items: projector: Epson PowerLite L690U (6,500 lumens, WUXGA, laser). It is ChatGPT's own mid-size pick and has a built-in HDBaseT input, so the cable run from the booth needs no receiver box at the ceiling.

signal link: an HDBaseT transmitter at the booth plus one Cat 5e STP or better cable (Epson's minimum). Cat 6a/7 is needed if the run is over 70 m and the source is 4K (AV Access's figures). AV Access 4KEX100-L is the approved-store option. It comes only as a pair, so the receiver is a spare.
mount: Epson's own Universal Projector Mount ELPMBPJG appears under accessories on the L690U page. No mount comes in the box.
screen: fixed or tensioned screen sized to the room. None of the approved Shopify stores sells a church-scale screen, so it would come from Amazon.

findings.label: Control Communications side effect
findings.value: Turning it on disables the projector's LAN and RS-232C ports
findings.source_title: Connecting to an HDBaseT Transmitter (Epson EB-L890E series User's Guide)
findings.note: Control Communications (Operation menu) must be On for the transmitter's Ethernet and serial ports to reach the projector. A separate 'Extron XTP' setting must be On only for Extron XTP transmitters or switchers. To control the projector while it is off, Standby Mode must be set to Normal.
